doc00064.name: Wireless Mouse
doc00064.description: 2.4 GHz wireless optical mouse with a nano USB-A receiver that stores inside the battery bay. Ergonomic right-hand shape with a precision scroll wheel, forward and back buttons and adjustable 800 / 1200 / 1600 DPI. Runs up to 12 months on a single AA battery. Plug-and-play on Windows, macOS and Linux.

doc00065.name: A4 Copy Paper (500 sheets)
doc00065.description: 80 gsm white A4 multipurpose paper (210 x 297 mm), 500 sheets per ream. Suitable for laser and inkjet printers, photocopiers and fax machines. Acid-free, with a smooth finish that feeds reliably and resists jamming. Each ream carries its own barcode so individual reams can be issued and returned.

doc00066.name: USB-C Cable 1m
doc00066.description: Braided nylon USB-C to USB-C cable, 1 metre, with a connector at each end. Supports USB 3.1 Gen 2 data transfer up to 10 Gbps, 60 W fast charging and video output on compatible devices. Reinforced strain relief and a reversible plug that fits either way round.

doc00067.name: DisplayPort Cable 2m
doc00067.description: DisplayPort 1.4 cable, 2 metres, with a DisplayPort male connector at each end. Carries video and audio up to 8K at 30 Hz or 4K at 120 Hz, with HDR support. Gold-plated latching connectors give a secure fit on monitors, docking stations and graphics cards.

doc00068.name: 27-inch Monitor
doc00068.description: 27-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS monitor with wide 178-degree viewing angles and a 75 Hz refresh rate. Inputs: 2 x HDMI 1.4, 1 x DisplayPort 1.2 and a 3.5 mm audio output. Height-adjustable stand with tilt and swivel, plus a 100 x 100 mm VESA mount. Flicker-free with a low blue-light mode.

doc00069.name: HD Webcam
doc00069.description: 1080p Full HD webcam recording at 30 frames per second with a 90-degree wide-angle lens and autofocus. Built-in dual noise-reducing microphones. Connects through a 1.5 m attached USB-A 2.0 cable, plug and play with no drivers. Clips onto a monitor or screws onto a standard tripod, and works with Teams, Zoom and Google Meet.

doc00070.name: Ethernet Patch Cable Cat6
doc00070.description: Cat6 patch cable with RJ45 connectors at both ends, 2 metres. Supports Gigabit Ethernet up to 1 Gbps (rated to 250 MHz) for switches, routers, access points and wall points. Snagless moulded boots protect the latch, and the shielded cable reduces interference.

doc00071.name: Solid State Drive 1TB
doc00071.description: 1 TB 2.5-inch SATA III solid state drive with sequential reads up to 550 MB/s and writes up to 520 MB/s. Connects through a standard SATA data port plus SATA power, in a 7 mm slim case that fits laptops and desktops. Shock-resistant with no moving parts, a quick way to upgrade an ageing hard drive.

doc00072.name: Business Laptop
doc00072.description: 14-inch business laptop with a Full HD anti-glare display, 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB NVMe SSD. Ports: 2 x USB-A 3.2, 2 x USB-C (Thunderbolt 4, charging and DisplayPort), 1 x HDMI 2.0, a 3.5 mm combo audio jack and a microSD reader. Backlit keyboard, fingerprint reader and Wi-Fi 6. Issued for the duration of a project.

doc00073.name: Wi-Fi Router
doc00073.description: Dual-band AC1200 Wi-Fi router (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz) with four external antennas. Ports: 1 x Gigabit WAN, 4 x Gigabit LAN and 1 x USB 3.0 for sharing storage. Supports guest networks, WPA3 and basic parental controls, and is configured through a web page. Ideal for labs and temporary office set-ups.

doc00074.name: Surge Protector Power Strip
doc00074.description: Six-outlet surge protector with an illuminated on/off switch and a protected and grounded indicator light. Absorbs up to 1800 joules and has a built-in overload breaker. 2 metre power cord, and keyhole mounting slots so it can be fixed to a wall or desk underside.

doc00075.name: Laser Toner Cartridge (Black)
doc00075.description: Black toner cartridge for departmental monochrome laser printers, with a page yield of about 3,000 pages at 5 percent coverage. Includes a new drum interface and chip, installs without tools, and prints sharp text and graphics. Currently withdrawn from lending.

doc00076.name: Desktop PC
doc00076.description: Compact desktop PC with a quad-core processor, 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD. Front ports: 2 x USB 3.2 and 1 x headphone/microphone combo jack. Rear ports: 1 x HDMI, 1 x DisplayPort, 1 x Gigabit Ethernet, 4 x USB 2.0 and 2 x audio jacks. Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are built in. Suited to labs and temporary workstations.

doc00077.name: UPS Battery Backup 1500VA
doc00077.description: 1500VA / 900 W line-interactive UPS with automatic voltage regulation and a front LCD showing input, output, load and runtime. Eight outlets: four with battery backup and surge protection, four surge-only. Includes a USB port for monitoring software and RJ45 network surge protection. Keeps equipment running through load-shedding and short power cuts.

doc00078.name: Network Switch 8-Port
doc00078.description: 8-port gigabit unmanaged Ethernet switch with 8 x 10/100/1000 RJ45 ports that auto-negotiate speed and cable type. Plug and play with no configuration, and LED indicators for link and activity on every port. Compact metal case with a fanless design, suited to desks, labs and small cabinets.

doc00079.name: Wireless Access Point
doc00079.description: Ceiling- or wall-mount Wi-Fi 6 access point, dual-band up to 1.8 Gbps, supporting more than 100 connected devices. One Gigabit Ethernet port that is powered over PoE (802.3af), so no separate power adapter is needed. Supports multiple SSIDs, VLANs and band steering. Mounting bracket included.

doc00080.name: Mechanical Keyboard
doc00080.description: Full-size mechanical keyboard with 104 keys including a numeric keypad. Tactile blue switches rated for 50 million keystrokes, with per-key backlighting and N-key rollover. Metal top plate with a removable cable and a USB-A connection. Compatible with Windows, macOS and Linux.

doc00081.name: External Hard Drive 2TB
doc00081.description: Portable 2 TB external hard drive in a slim, shock-resistant case. Supports USB 3.0 (5 Gbps), with both a USB-A and a USB-C connection cable included. Powered over USB with no external adapter. Pre-formatted for Windows and also usable on macOS and Linux. Ideal for backups and moving large datasets.

doc00082.name: Ultrabook Laptop 14-inch
doc00082.description: Lightweight 14-inch ultrabook weighing about 1.3 kg, with a Full HD display, 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD. Ports: 2 x USB-C (Thunderbolt 4), 1 x USB-A 3.2, 1 x HDMI 2.0 and a 3.5 mm audio jack. Up to 12 hours of battery life. Popular for conferences and fieldwork.

doc00083.name: USB Flash Drive 64GB
doc00083.description: 64 GB USB 3.0 flash drive with read speeds up to 120 MB/s. Retractable USB-A connector, so there is no cap to lose, and a loop for a lanyard or key ring. Compatible with Windows, macOS and Linux.

doc00084.name: HDMI Cable 2m
doc00084.description: High-speed HDMI 2.0 cable, 2 metres, with HDMI Type A male connectors at both ends. Supports 4K at 60 Hz, HDR and Ethernet channel, and carries up to 8 channels of audio. Gold-plated connectors and a shielded cable for a clean picture.

doc00085.name: 24-inch Monitor
doc00085.description: 24-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS monitor with a 75 Hz refresh rate. Inputs: 1 x HDMI 1.4, 1 x VGA and a 3.5 mm audio output. Tilt-adjustable stand and a 75 x 75 mm VESA mount. Slim bezel design suited to lecture rooms and office desks.

doc00086.name: High-Yield Toner Cartridge (Black)
doc00086.description: High-yield black toner cartridge for shared monochrome laser printers, with a page yield of about 6,000 pages at 5 percent coverage. Includes a new drum interface and chip, and installs without tools. A better fit than the standard cartridge for busy printers.

doc00087.name: Compact Wireless Mouse
doc00087.description: Compact 2.4 GHz wireless mouse sized for laptop bags, with a nano USB-A receiver that stores in the battery bay. 1000 DPI optical sensor and a quiet-click scroll wheel. Runs on one AA battery for up to 18 months. Plug and play on Windows, macOS and Linux.

doc00088.name: Network Switch 24-Port
doc00088.description: 24-port gigabit managed Ethernet switch with 24 x 10/100/1000 RJ45 ports and 2 x SFP uplink slots. Supports VLANs, QoS, link aggregation and port mirroring, configured through a web interface. Rack-mountable in a 19-inch rack (1U), with LED indicators on every port.
